estimatedEffort: Multiple independently reviewable implementation increments; no calendar commitment until FND-5/FND-6 dependencies are mapped.

dependencies.name: OBS Studio Browser Source
dependencies.purpose: Render the local overlay URL in OBS; manually verify actual app behavior by OS/version.

dependencies.name: Fastify / PostgreSQL / Prisma / vanilla JavaScript
dependencies.purpose: Reuse current API, static app, and durable local persistence; no additional dependency planned.

dependencies.name: FND-2
dependencies.purpose: Queue domain rules, viewer identity, and safe field source.

dependencies.name: FND-5
dependencies.purpose: Hard prerequisite: all account/call/service projections must be complete and verified before any FND-7 implementation.

dependencies.name: FND-6
dependencies.purpose: Hard prerequisite: protected panel/session/CSRF/Host-Origin foundations must be complete before any FND-7 implementation.

tddContract: Every behavior increment starts with a failing behavioral test, then minimum implementation to Green, followed by separate Refactor and retest. PostgreSQL guarantees use isolated PostgreSQL and actual versioned Prisma migrations. Record exact commands/results in docs/stories.md and docs/pt-BR/stories.md; do not claim OBS/OS compatibility or FND-7 tests without observed evidence.

phases.name: Readiness and UX approval gates
phases.description: No schema, backend, or UI implementation begins until upstream readiness and UX decisions are documented.

subtasks.description: Verify FND-5 and FND-6 are fully complete and map every required atomic field to delivered application projections and protected panel/security services; block FND-7 if any prerequisite is incomplete.

verification.instructions: Record upstream story statuses, source service/API for all seven dynamic fields, panel/session/CSRF/Host-Origin primitives, and an explicit all-fields-ready decision. No reduced field subset.

subtasks.description: Complete UX review and record accepted font labels, default style, preview, empty/stale/unavailable states, accessible labels/focus, and consistency with existing panel before any UI coding.

verification.instructions: @aiox-ux-design-expert approves the journey, loading/error/empty/revocation states, keyboard access, labels, visible focus and readability preview.

subtasks.description: Write and validate shared Unicode code-point counting examples for 240-character fixed and fallback text.

verification.instructions: Document same code-point rule for browser and server and boundary examples at 240 and 241.

phases.name: Widget persistence foundation
phases.description: Test and add durable widget configuration and capability hash after all phase-0 gates pass.

subtasks.description: Write real PostgreSQL migration-contract tests for widget create/edit/delete, capability hashing, widget scope, rotation, revocation, and restart durability.
Add the Prisma widget model and SQL migration after the database tests fail for the missing behavior.

phases.name: Core field and capability policy
phases.description: Implement allowlisted data fields, styling validation, and capability lifecycle.

subtasks.description: Write unit tests for field scope, queue selection, fallback states, 240-character Unicode counting, style allowlists, and malicious input.
Implement pure overlay field and style validation after observing behavioral Red.
Write token lifecycle unit tests for random generation, hash-only persistence boundary, one-widget scope, and rotation/revocation.
Implement capability issue/verify/revoke policy and retest after Refactor.

phases.name: Widget repository and application service
phases.description: Implement durable widget CRUD and capability lifecycle through a service after repository contract tests pass.

subtasks.description: Write real PostgreSQL/application service tests for create/edit/delete, token issue/hash verification, one-time URL, rotate/revoke, and concurrent delete/read atomicity.
Implement repository plus application service for widget persistence and capability lifecycle after observing Red.

phases.name: HTTP management and scoped read routes
phases.description: Connect protected panel operations and isolated read-only OBS access.

subtasks.description: Write HTTP contract tests for management session/CSRF, Host/Origin, token scope, rejected/revoked capabilities, exact data projection, cache/referrer headers, and absence of mutations.
Implement widget management and token-only read routes through shared application/domain projections.

phases.name: Browser Source renderer
phases.description: Build safe transparent renderer with update, empty, stale, recovery, and revoke states.

subtasks.description: Write browser tests for safe text, transparent page, selected style, two-second update, empty fallback, transient stale marker, recovery, and 401/403 clearing. Run eight concurrently open widgets on mixed dynamic fields; measure committed-change-to-rendered-DOM over 10 consecutive changes, each <=2s, and record environment.

verification.instructions: Run against the app and isolated migrated PostgreSQL.

subtasks.description: Implement the single-widget local renderer and no-faster-than-needed polling using local assets only.

phases.name: Panel controls and integration
phases.description: Refine the UX and add widget source, style, preview, and link lifecycle controls.

subtasks.description: Complete UX review for safe font menu, initial style, empty/stale labels, preview, and link secrecy guidance before panel UI coding.

verification.instructions: Review against existing panel/UX guidance; record selected values and confirm no arbitrary CSS or remote assets.

subtasks.description: Write panel browser tests for widget create/edit/delete, field and queue selection, style preview, validation, copy, revoke, and regenerate.

verification.instructions: Run the operator panel against the local app.

subtasks.description: Implement tested overlay management controls in the existing local panel.

phases.name: End-to-end, OBS acceptance, and documentation
phases.description: Verify integrated behavior, document only observed support, and run project quality gates.

subtasks.description: Verify complete create-to-revoke flow and two-second propagation against real local app/database. Use eight concurrent widgets and record 10 consecutive committed-change-to-rendered-DOM measurements, each <=2s.

verification.instructions: Use isolated real PostgreSQL migrations and measure propagation.

subtasks.description: Manually verify OBS Browser Source dimensions, transparency, live state, failures, recovery, and link rotation.

verification.instructions: Record OS, OBS version, exact steps, and observed outcome; do not infer support for untested platforms.

subtasks.description: Publish bilingual guides and record exact implementation evidence and quality gate results.

verification.command: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run review:static && npm run validate:version && npm exec prisma validate && docker compose config --quiet && git diff --check

workflowDeviation: The Spec Pipeline declares plan.json while plan-create-implementation.md emits plan/implementation.yaml. Both expected artifacts are provided: this pipeline summary follows docs/stories/FND-0/spec/plan.json and the detailed plan follows the declared implementation task schema.
nextSteps: Wait until FND-5 and FND-6 are fully complete; verify every atomic source projection and protected panel primitive.
Complete and record @aiox-ux-design-expert approval before any panel UI implementation.
Begin Red/Green/Refactor only after story approval and phase-0 gates.
